item.title: Design proposals for Trump's Dulles International Airport overhaul include Zaha Hadid Architects, Adjaye Associates, Grimshaw
item.description: Competing design proposals have been unveiled for a new terminal at Washington Dulles International Airport. Last month, President Trump called for a rebuilding of the airport, reportedly calling the existing Eero Saarinen facilities “terrible” and “incorrectly designed.” Proposal by Zaha Hadid Architects and Bermello Ajamil & Partners. Image courtesy of the Department of TransportationSeveral major design studios have now responded to a call from the Department of Transportation for proposals.

item.title: JURASSIC in Chengdu by SAKO Architects
item.description: The children’s floor of a shopping mall in Chengdu has been designed as a public area with multiple shops under the theme “The Jurassic World Where Dinosaurs Thrived.” This concept celebrates the grandeur and scale of the Jurassic era—when everything was larger than life—through recurring motifs of dinosaur teeth, eggs, spots, and the stems of climbing plants. item.title: Níall McLaughlin awarded 2026 RIBA Royal Gold Medal
item.description: The Royal Institute of British Architects has awarded the 2026 Royal Gold Medal for architecture to Níall McLaughlin. Described by the RIBA as one of the world’s highest honors in the architecture field, the award was given to the Irish architect, educator, and writer for what RIBA called his “resounding impact spanning architectural practice, thinking, writing and education.”

item.title: 15 projects 'shaping contemporary life' honored at 2026 Créateurs Design Awards
